layers.title: Population density (500 m grid)

layers.title: Population density by ward (Census 2011)
layers.legend: Residents per km² of ward area, Census 2011 (ward area includes parks, industry, farmland)

layers.title: Population group by ward (Census 2011, optional)
layers.note: Not a colour layer. Fields pct_black_african, pct_coloured, pct_asian, pct_white, pct_other (Stats SA self-identified population-group categories, denominator popgroup_total) are included for popups only, to explain the spatial legacy of apartheid-era Group Areas. Label factually.
layers.source: Stats SA Census 2011, via City of Cape Town 2011 ward profiles (Jan 2013); ward boundaries Stats SA 2011 (published by UCT Libraries). Stats SA copyright: free use with attribution.

layers.title: Median house valuation by suburb (GV2025)
layers.legend: Median municipal valuation of freehold residential property, General Valuation 2025
layers.source: City of Cape Town Open Data Portal, 'Valuations Suburbs for 2022 and 2025' (freehold residential only) joined to 'Official Planning Suburbs'; City of Cape Town open data terms of use. Suburbs with <20 freehold properties or <20 per km² (farms, reserves) omitted; informal areas have no value.
